title: Publish negatives and formalize two theorems
original_requirement: Write the negative-results ECDLP manuscript covering the six named results and formalize the two requested theorems in Lean.
acceptance_criteria: Link every claim to its exact proof, counterexample or experiment and hypotheses. Separate conditional barriers from bounded experimental negatives.
Place the manuscript under papers/, with bibliography, reproducibility bundle and explicit review/submission status.
Faithfully state the two Lean theorems, audit axioms and check the build. Claim publication or submission only with its actual receipt.
remaining_gaps: A current proof inventory and novelty audit must bind exact sources for all six named negative results before a synthesis claim.
No manuscript or Lean proof of the two requested theorems is delivered by this preparation. The existing GenericInvariance.lean is an adjacent reference.
Lean/toolchain and renderer availability remain to be confirmed. Reviewed theorem assumptions are part of the acceptance criteria.
execution_note: Commands are source bindings, not launch receipts; preserve original trials and output to a fresh location through the applicable runner. No official approval or status transition is implied.
original_audit_text: Publish the negative results. Nagao's Lemma 4 is false, Semaev 2015's Assumption 1 fails off the diagonal, the compact-orbit pipeline is provably generic, yield is conserved, the monodromy is C₂^{m−2}, and isogeny oracles are generic. The publication list has no ECDLP entry. Formalising the two theorems in Lean would make them citable.
